operation_ordering.query_text: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name
SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = ?

SELECT s.subject_id FROM service_deployed_to_deployment s
JOIN deployments d ON d.id = s.object_id
WHERE d.label = 'Production'
SELECT id FROM modules ORDER BY id

SELECT sim.subject_id as service
FROM service_implements_module sim
JOIN module_depends_on_package mdp ON mdp.subject_id = sim.object_id
WHERE mdp.object_id = 'package:fx12-legacy'

WITH RECURSIVE affected_modules(module_id) AS (
  SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = 'package:fx12-legacy'
  UNION
  SELECT mdm.subject_id FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
  JOIN affected_modules am ON mdm.object_id = am.module_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id
FROM service_implements_module sim
JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
ORDER BY 1

WITH RECURSIVE affected_modules(module_id) AS (
  SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = 'package:fx12-legacy'
  UNION
  SELECT mdm.subject_id FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
  JOIN affected_modules am ON mdm.object_id = am.module_id
),
affected_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
),
prod_services AS (
  SELECT sdd.subject_id AS service_id, sdd.object_id AS deployment_id
  FROM service_deployed_to_deployment sdd
  JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sdd.object_id
  JOIN task_retires_package trp ON trp.subject_id = ttd.subject_id
  WHERE trp.object_id = 'package:fx12-legacy'
    AND ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx12-cutover'
)
SELECT a.service_id, p.deployment_id
FROM affected_services a
JOIN prod_services p ON p.service_id = a.service_id
JOIN service_crosses_boundary scb ON scb.subject_id = a.service_id
LEFT JOIN test_verifies_service tvs ON tvs.object_id = a.service_id
WHERE tvs.object_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 1

WITH RECURSIVE affected_modules(module_id) AS (
  SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = 'package:fx12-legacy'
  UNION
  SELECT mdm.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
  JOIN affected_modules am ON mdm.object_id = am.module_id
),
affected_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.service_id
FROM affected_services a
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdd ON sdd.subject_id = a.service_id
JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd
  ON ttd.object_id = sdd.object_id AND ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx12-cutover'
JOIN task_retires_package trp
  ON trp.subject_id = 'task:fx12-cutover' AND trp.object_id = 'package:fx12-legacy'
JOIN service_crosses_boundary scb ON scb.subject_id = a.service_id
LEFT JOIN test_verifies_service tvs ON tvs.object_id = a.service_id
WHERE tvs.object_id IS NULL
ORDER BY a.service_id

WITH RECURSIVE affected_modules(module_id) AS (
  SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = 'package:fx12-legacy'
  UNION
  SELECT mdm.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module mdm
  JOIN affected_modules am ON mdm.object_id = am.module_id
),
affected_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
),
boundary_unverified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.service_id
  FROM affected_services a
  JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdd ON sdd.subject_id = a.service_id
  JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd
    ON ttd.object_id = sdd.object_id AND ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx12-cutover'
  JOIN task_retires_package trp
    ON trp.subject_id = 'task:fx12-cutover' AND trp.object_id = 'package:fx12-legacy'
  JOIN service_crosses_boundary scb ON scb.subject_id = a.service_id
  LEFT JOIN test_verifies_service tvs ON tvs.object_id = a.service_id
  WHERE tvs.object_id IS NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT sdd.object_id
FROM boundary_unverified bu
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdd ON sdd.subject_id = bu.service_id
JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd
  ON ttd.object_id = sdd.object_id AND ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx12-cutover'
ORDER BY sdd.object_id
